cut: Global 2, VIRAL CUT v1 (23 Oct) of Ends in 3 — owner, 23 Oct: 'Test other 2 as well' (the viral format, plan/films/23b-ends-in-3-viral.md). The hook is frame 0; the last frame hands back to it.
argument: Mexico cut off 2.2 million lines ending in 3 for not linking an ID, against extortion and fraud; the 5s are due 31 October; cut-off phones still get the earthquake alert.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: [2.2 million] phone / lines cut off / in Mexico.
text.ja: [220万] 回線が / メキシコで / 停止。

captions.source: CRT figures via El Financiero, 5 Oct 2026: 2,248,143 lines ending in 3 suspended after their deadline (30 Sep, grace to 3 Oct), as of 4 Oct; about 1.21 million reactivated by then. Search summaries, 23 Oct (plan/films/23-ends-in-3.md).

text.en: Every line needs / an ID. The reason: / [extortion, fraud].
text.fi: Jokainen liittymä tarvitsee / tunnuksen. Syy: / [kiristys, petokset].
text.ja: 全回線に IDが 必要。 / 理由は [恐喝と 詐欺]。

captions.source: Mexico's telecom regulator, the CRT: since 9 Jan 2026 every mobile line must be linked to its holder's name and CURP (national ID number) through the phone company; the stated aim is to end the anonymous lines used for extortion and fraud (El Financiero, Mexico News Daily, Crónica; search summaries, 23 Oct).

text.en: Ending in 4: cut. / Ending in 5: due / [31 October].
text.ja: 末尾4は 停止。 / 末尾5の 期限は / [10月31日]。

captions.source: The CRT's calendar by last digit (0 on 15 Aug to 9 on 31 Dec). Lines ending in 4 were due 15 Oct and suspended about 72 hours later (Informador 19 Oct: more than a million); lines ending in 5 are due 31 Oct, with suspension about 72 hours after (Expansión, UnoTV, El Mañana, Récord; search summaries, 23 Oct).

text.en: No calls, no data. / Number kept till / you [link an ID].
text.fi: Ei puheluita, ei dataa. / Numero säilyy, kunnes / [tunnus liitetään].
text.ja: 通話も データも 不可。 / 番号は 残る。 / [IDを 登録] すれば 戻る。

captions.source: CRT, as carried by El Universal, Milenio, Xataka, Ruptura360 and El Imparcial (search summaries, 23 Oct): a suspended line cannot make or receive ordinary calls, send texts or use data; it is not cancelled, the number is not lost, and service returns as soon as the line is linked.

text.en: No ID, no phone. / The quake alert / still [gets through].
text.fi: Ei tunnusta, ei puhelinta. / Maanjäristysvaroitus / [menee silti läpi].
text.ja: IDなし、 電話なし。 / それでも 地震警報は / [届く]。

captions.source: The station's line, over its own image. The fact under it: a suspended line still receives the seismic alert and can still call 911, other emergency and citizen-service numbers and its phone company (CRT via El Universal, Milenio, Xataka, ADN40, El Imparcial; search summaries, 23 Oct). Not a quote.

calendar.ja: CRT · 末尾の 数字ごとの 期限

digits.why: each phone shows the last digit of its line; numbers, the same in every master

calendar.why: the calendar of deadlines by last digit (CRT); digits and day/month dates, the same in every master

id.why: the card's band and the name of Mexico's national ID number; the photo is a mask, no face, no name

alert.en: a triangle with a seismograph trace
alert.why: the alert screen is an icon only, so no master says the wrong words; it shows an alert, never a quake

post.en: 2.2 million phone lines cut off in Mexico. Every line must now be linked to its owner's ID, against extortion and fraud. Ending in 4: cut. Ending in 5: due 31 Oct. A cut-off phone still gets the earthquake alert. What does your number end in? #Mexico
post.es: México suspendió 2,2 millones de líneas terminadas en 3: cada línea debe vincularse a la CURP de su titular, contra la extorsión y el fraude. Terminación 4: suspendidas. Terminación 5: vence el 31 de octubre. Aún reciben la alerta sísmica. ¿En qué termina la tuya?
post.fi: Meksiko katkaisi 2,2 miljoonaa liittymää: jokainen liittymä on nyt sidottava omistajan henkilötunnukseen kiristyksen ja petosten torjumiseksi. Loppunumero 4: katkaistu. Loppunumero 5: määräaika 31.10. Katkaistu puhelin saa yhä maanjäristysvaroituksen. Mihin numerosi päättyy?
post.ja: メキシコで220万回線が停止。全ての携帯回線を持ち主のIDに結びつける義務、狙いは恐喝と詐欺の対策。末尾4は停止済み、末尾5の期限は10月31日。停止された電話にも地震警報は届く。あなたの番号の末尾は？
